falseForms.violation: moves the stress from u (where the Greek puts it) to E — a different word with a different rhythm; the sources stress u and nothing else

falseForms.origin: the circumflex habit — writers who learned that "the little hat means Greek" and apply it wherever an acute belongs
falseForms.violation: the source carries an acute (oxeia, a rising tone), not a circumflex (perispomene, a rise-fall): the two marks are different facts about pitch, and only the acute is attested on u
